svg.text: Harold Lloyd, "Safety Last!" (1923): the three cuts for DeadDays (side view, the wall to the right; red = right arm/leg; grey line = the step edge, 2 m)
hands up from head height to overhead, feet swing under: reach up and take hold
arms straight, legs low and kicking: the dangle (loops 182 -> 132)
knees drawn up to the edge, arms bend, head ducks: hauling himself up
